verdict.rationale: Docusign supports natural-language interaction indirectly via its MCP connector for Claude/Gemini CLI/Copilot, letting users query agreements and trigger workflow actions in natural language through an AI assistant, plus AI-Assisted Review chat and Q&A features for agreements. However, this is mediated through third-party AI clients rather than a native NL command interface built into Docusign itself, and there's no independent evidence of robustness or breadth of commands supported. missing for 10: first-party evidence of a native NL command interface (not just via external MCP clients), independent hands-on validation of natural-language command coverage/reliability, and detail on the range of actions controllable via NL beyond querying/triggering workflows.
